name: beaver-nest
description: Private Phoenix LiveView family app for Tailscale-based home hosting.

scripts.start: BNEST_STABLE=${BNEST_STABLE:-true} PORT=${BNEST_DEV_PORT:-4020} ./hippo run --class service --resource-tier standard --disk-path . --cwd apps/bnest-app --lease-port ${BNEST_DEV_PORT:-4020} --lease-owner development --lease-min 4020 --lease-max 4029 -- mix phx.server
scripts.tailnet:up: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:up
scripts.tailnet:status: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:status
scripts.tailnet:down: npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t tailnet:down
scripts.test: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app -t test:unit
scripts.test:e2e:be: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier standard --disk-path . -- npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app-be-e2e -t test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:fe: ./hippo run --class ephemeral --resource-tier heavy --disk-path . -- npm exec -- nx run -p bnest-app-fe-e2e -t test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:be && npm run test:e2e:fe

author: wahidyankf
